invoice.instructions: Output every printed table row, even when stamped over or when consecutive rows repeat the same code, description, and price. Never skip or merge rows. Start a new section whenever a printed section header row appears in the table. Use null for section_name only for rows at the top of a continuation page before the first section header on that page. Do not invent section names not printed in the table, do not output empty sections, and do not copy a section or its rows into another section.

outpatient_invoice.instructions: Ignore the small insurance Claim No / Batch / Date barcode sticker at the top: do not copy its Claim No, Batch, Date, or name into receipt_number, receipt_date, stay, or relationship. Return null for any field not printed on the invoice (such as relationship, admission_date, discharge_date, paid, remaining, or receipt_number on lab/doctor bills). Put the Arabic service name in description and the English service name in english_description; never swap them and never translate Arabic text into English (return null if no English name is printed). Output every printed table row and never skip or merge rows.
